head.text: WF-006 OP-005 PCM short frame with four slots, one masked slot (success)

foot.text: Cell = one bit clock, four 8-bit slots, slot mask 0xD (slot 1 masked), tri-state bit set, words 0xC3, 0x5A, 0x96 for slots 0, 2 and 3. Preset 3: frame sync of one bit, one bit before slot 0. In the masked slot the enable o_sdo_oe is low (the line is released) and o_sdo_0 stays 0.
